A manifest's headline verdict

Source: R/manifest_summary.R
manifest_summary.Rd

Builds the typed, classed list that goes in a manifest's summary property: the headline label of a non-ensemble inference, whether the emitter abstained, why it abstained, and any key metrics behind the call.

Usage

manifest_summary(
  headline,
  abstained = FALSE,
  metrics = list(),
  abstain_reason = NA_character_
)

Arguments

headline

A single non-empty string stating the conclusion, for example "effect detected" or "insufficient evidence".

abstained

A single logical. TRUE when the emitter declined to stand behind a result. Coerced with isTRUE() on the way in, so a missing value is recorded as FALSE.

metrics

A named list of the key numbers behind the headline, for example an effect size, a p-value, or an effective sample size. Keep it small; it is a summary, not a results table.

abstain_reason

A single string explaining an abstention, or NA_character_ when the emitter did not abstain.

Value

A list of class manifest_summary with elements headline, abstained, abstain_reason and metrics.

Details

The slot exists because a verdict and an ensemble are different shapes of result. A causal test or a decision produces one labelled conclusion, not a matrix of draws, and the alternative – smuggling it into params as a single-row table – leaves consumers unable to distinguish a verdict from a degenerate posterior. Because summary is inside the integrity hash, a tampered verdict is detected exactly like a tampered payload.

An abstention is a first-class outcome here, not a failure. A component that will not stand behind a number reports abstained = TRUE with a reason, and a downstream gate treats that as "no usable result from this lens" rather than reading a number that was never meant to be trusted.

See also

orchestra_manifest for the property this fills.

Author

Max Moldovan

Examples

manifest_summary("effect detected", metrics = list(estimate = 0.42))
#> $headline
#> [1] "effect detected"
#> 
#> $abstained
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $abstain_reason
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $metrics
#> $metrics$estimate
#> [1] 0.42
#> 
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "manifest_summary"

manifest_summary(
  "insufficient evidence",
  abstained = TRUE,
  abstain_reason = "effective sample size below the floor"
)
#> $headline
#> [1] "insufficient evidence"
#> 
#> $abstained
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $abstain_reason
#> [1] "effective sample size below the floor"
#> 
#> $metrics
#> list()
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "manifest_summary"
